text:
Keiko: Yesterday I finished the CSV export. Today I'm picking up the retry bug on the sync worker. No blockers.
Tom: I'm still on the SSO integration, I'll have a PR up by end of day.
Lena: Same as yesterday, reviewing PRs.
note: Forward commitment with a deadline (PR by EOD) counts as an action item.

text:
Marco: Quick one from me, the staging deploy failed again overnight. Does anyone know who changed the Terraform state bucket?
Aisha: Not me.
Jun: Not me either, I've been on the onboarding flow all week.
Marco: Okay, weird. Moving on.
note: Question asked, nobody answers it.

text:
Dev: For Bluepeak, the inventory sync is done, I'm just waiting on their team for API credentials.
Sara: I can ping their PM, I've got a call with her at two anyway.
Dev: That'd be great, thanks.
note: Implicit action item: 'I can ping their PM'.

text:
Jun: Did anyone watch the match last night?
Aisha: Ugh, don't remind me, penalties again.
Marco: I fell asleep at half time, honestly.
Jun: Classic. Okay, okay, let's start. Who's first?
note: Pre-meeting chatter.

text:
Greta: Heads up, I'll be out Thursday and Friday. I've got a follow-up with my cardiologist and they might keep me overnight.
Tom: Oh no, hope it's all okay. Take whatever time you need.
Lena: Thanks. Keiko, can you cover my on-call shift Thursday?
Priya: Yeah, I've got it.
note: Health information; on-call cover accepted (action).

text:
Aisha: The flaky e2e test failed six times this week.
Marco: Let's just quarantine it for now and file a ticket.
Jun: Agreed.
Aisha: Okay, I'll move it to the quarantine suite after standup.

Tom: Orbital's route optimizer is still timing out above 500 stops. Is it our solver or their geocoding API? Nobody knows yet.
Sara: Okay. Keep us posted.
Tom: Will do.
note: 'Keep us posted / will do' is too vague to be an action item.

text:
Jun: I couldn't get into the analytics dashboard, the shared login stopped working.
Marco: It got rotated on Monday. It's ops-admin, and the password is Winter2026! with a capital W.
Jun: Got it, thanks.
note: Credential spoken aloud.

text:
Keiko: Done with the migration script, it's merged. Today, docs for it.
Tom: I'm blocked on design for the settings page, still no mockups.
Lena: I'll chase Hana for the mockups today.
Tom: Thanks.

Sara: Lumen's render farm job queue has been green since last night's patch. Nothing else from me.
Dev: Same here, the Lumen billing report is basically done.
Sara: Cool, that's everyone.
note: Status updates only, no new commitments.

text:
Karen: We need the audit log export before our regulator review on the 14th.
Ben: Understood. We'll ship the export to your sandbox by the 10th so your team has a few days to check it.
Karen: Perfect.
note: Karen is Northwind Bank's compliance lead.

text:
Dr. Osei: For the pilot we'll be pulling real intake notes, so things like a patient's HIV status or psychiatric history will be in the text.
Ben: That's going to change where we host it.
Dr. Osei: Right. So which environment will we use?
Ben: Let me check with our security lead before I commit to anything.
note: Dr. Osei is from Helio Health. Question deferred, not answered.

text:
Ana: We looked at both options. We'll go with the phased rollout, starting with the twelve Lisbon stores in March.
Raj: Great, that's what we'd recommend too.
Ana: And the big-bang option is off the table, the board won't accept the risk.
note: Ana is Bluepeak Retail's program manager.

text:
Raj: One option is that we host the optimizer on our side and you call it as an API.
Felix: Honestly, that's a no for us. Legal won't let shipment data leave our VPC.
Raj: Understood, we'll drop that idea then.
note: Felix is Orbital Freight's CTO. A rejected proposal is still a decision.

text:
Mia: Sorry, I'm a few minutes late, the traffic in Porto was terrible.
Ben: No worries at all. How was the festival last weekend?
Mia: Amazing, our short film got screened and the crowd loved it.
Ben: Oh, congratulations!
note: Mia is Lumen Studios' producer.

text:
Karen: Does the export include deleted records?
Ben: Yes. Soft-deleted records are included with a deleted_at timestamp. Hard deletes are not, they're purged after 30 days.
Karen: Okay, that works for the auditors.
note: Question that does get answered.

text:
Dr. Osei: What would the per-seat price be if we expand to all three clinics?
Ben: I don't have the number in front of me. Let me get you a quote by Friday.
Dr. Osei: Fine, and send it to Martin in procurement too.
note: Question deferred to a follow-up, so still open in this chunk.

text:
Ana: One thing we haven't figured out: who owns the product catalog after go-live, your team or ours?
Raj: Good question. We should probably talk about that with your ops lead.
Ana: Yeah, she's out this week though.
note: 'We should probably talk' has no owner or commitment, so not an action item.

text:
Felix: Fine, we'll approve the extra two sprints for the customs module.
Raj: Thank you. I'll send the updated SOW today and we'll start Monday.
Felix: Send it to me and copy finance.

Mia: To get into our asset server you'll need the VPN. The username is lumen-ext and the temporary password is Tq7!rB92, it expires end of month.
Ben: Got it. Maybe don't send that over a call next time, let's use the vault.
Mia: Ha, fair.
note: Credential shared by the client.

text:
Nina: I wanted to bring up comp. I'm at 92k and the market rate for my level seems closer to 110.
Paul: I hear you. The review cycle is in March. I'll put you forward for an adjustment and get back to you on the band by end of month.
Nina: Thanks.
note: Salary.

text:
Paul: Where do you see yourself in a year, more on the management track or staying an IC?
Nina: Honestly, I don't know yet. I like mentoring but I'd miss coding.
Paul: That's fine, no need to decide now.
note: Question responded to but explicitly left unresolved.

text:
Paul: How was the trip?
Nina: So good. We did the whole coast in four days, the kids loved the aquarium.
Paul: We went there last summer, the jellyfish room is unreal.
Nina: Right? Okay, anyway.

Nina: I should tell you, I've been dealing with pretty bad anxiety lately, and my therapist suggested I cut back on late meetings.
Paul: Thanks for telling me. Let's move your evening syncs with the US team to mornings. I'll talk to Greg about it this week.
Nina: That would help a lot.
note: Mental health information.

text:
Paul: The design doc was solid, but the rollout section was thin.
Nina: Yeah, I rushed that part.
Paul: Could you flesh it out before the review on Thursday?
Nina: Sure.
note: Action item agreed with a one-word reply.

text:
Nina: I was thinking of rewriting the notifications service in Go.
Paul: I'd rather not this quarter, we don't have the headcount to support two stacks. Let's revisit in Q3.
Nina: Okay, fair enough.
note: Rejected proposal = decision; 'revisit in Q3' has no owner.

text:
Paul: I need to talk about Leo. He's missed three deadlines and HR has asked me to put him on a performance improvement plan. Keep this between us.
Nina: Understood. Is there anything I should do differently as his tech lead?
Paul: Not for now. Just keep doing what you're doing.
note: HR/performance information about a named person.

text:
Nina: Do we have budget for the conference in Berlin?
Paul: I genuinely don't know, finance changed the process. I'll ask Carla and get back to you.
Nina: Cool.

Paul: How's the Helio project treating you?
Nina: Stressful. Their team keeps changing the intake form fields every week.
Paul: Let's set a freeze date. From next Monday, no more field changes without a change request.
Nina: Yes please. I'll tell Dr. Osei on Wednesday's call.
note: Internal 1:1 about a client project.

text:
Nina: Before we start, did you try that ramen place I mentioned?
Paul: Not yet, it's always got a queue.
Nina: Go at like 5:30, no line.
Paul: Noted. Okay, let's look at your goals.

Hana: For Q1 we commit to three things: offline mode, the new onboarding, and SSO. Anything else goes to the backlog.
Marco: Agreed.
Hana: Marco, can you turn that into epics by Wednesday?
Marco: Will do.

Jun: How many points is the search rewrite?
Aisha: Could be eight, could be twenty, depends on whether we keep the old index.
Hana: And do we keep the old index?
Aisha: That's the thing, nobody's decided.

Tom: What if we drop Windows support for the beta?
Hana: No. Half our design partners are on Windows. We're keeping it.
Tom: Okay.
note: Rejected proposal; the question is answered.

text:
Sara: Bluepeak wants the loyalty integration in the same release as checkout.
Dev: That's too much for one sprint.
Hana: Then we split it: checkout in sprint 14, loyalty in sprint 15. I'll tell Ana.
Sara: Works for me.

Aisha: I'd like to propose we move to two-week sprints instead of one.
Marco: I'm not sure, our clients are used to weekly demos.
Hana: Let's think about it and discuss at the retro.
Aisha: Okay.
note: Proposal deferred: no decision, no owned task, no explicit question.

text:
Greta: The Orbital customs module depends on their EU tariff feed, which they say will be ready 'sometime in Q2'.
Hana: Can we build against a mock in the meantime?
Lena: Yes, the schema is published, so mocking is easy.
Hana: Then do that, and flag the dependency in the plan.
note: Question answered; instruction 'do that' is an assigned task.

text:
Marco: Before we start, there's cake in the kitchen, it's Jun's birthday.
Jun: Thirty-two, don't ask.
Hana: Happy birthday! Okay, grab cake, we start in two minutes.

Hana: Headcount: we can hire one senior backend engineer, budget up to 140k base. Please don't share that number outside this room.
Marco: Can we split it into two juniors instead?
Hana: Finance said no, it's one senior.
note: Compensation budget, marked confidential.

text:
Dev: Do we keep supporting the old mobile app version after launch?
Hana: Good question.
Dev: And who sends the migration emails, marketing or us?
Hana: Let's park both and get answers from product.
note: 'Get answers from product' has no owner.

text:
Sara: Lumen asked for a cost estimate for the 8K pipeline.
Tom: Rough guess, six weeks for two engineers.
Sara: I'll write that up with a range and send it to Mia by Thursday.
Tom: Add a buffer for the codec licensing.

Aisha: What went well: the release went out on time. What didn't: we found the payments bug in prod.
Marco: We should add contract tests for the payments API.
Hana: Agreed, let's make that a must for next sprint. Marco, can you own it?
Marco: Yep.
note: Retro.

text:
Ruth: Q3 revenue was up 18 percent, and we closed our largest customer to date. Thank you all.
Ruth: Next, the office move. We're moving into the new space on Rua Augusta in January.
note: All-hands; announced decision.

text:
Paul: So what are your salary expectations?
Omar: I'm currently on 85 and I'm looking for around 100.
Paul: Okay, that's within range. And your notice period?
Omar: One month.
note: Job interview; salary; questions answered.

text:
Greta: The outage started at 14:02 when the cert expired.
Tom: Why didn't the expiry alert fire?
Lena: We still don't know, the alerting config looks right.
Tom: That's the scary part.
note: Incident review.

text:
Kai: And here you can see the dashboard updating in real time.
Hana: What's the pricing for fifty seats?
Kai: For fifty it's twelve dollars a seat per month, billed annually.
Hana: Okay, thanks.
note: Vendor demo (Kai is a vendor, not a client). All-negative chunk.

text:
Tom: Action items from this incident: Greta adds cert expiry monitoring to the runbook, and I'll set up auto-renewal with cert-manager by next Friday.
Lena: Sure.
Tom: And we agreed, no more manual certs in prod.
note: Incident review follow-up.

text:
Jun: Anyone up for the climbing gym on Thursday?
Aisha: I'm in!
Marco: Me too, if I can find my shoes.
Jun: Great, I'll book for three.
note: Social plan: 'I'll book' is not a work action item.

text:
Paul: Thoughts on Omar?
Hana: Strong on systems design, weak on testing.
Lena: I'd hire.
Paul: Okay, we'll make an offer. I'll talk to HR today about the number.
note: Hiring debrief: evaluation of a named candidate is sensitive.

text:
Ben: In this training I'll show how to tag a meeting. You click here, pick the label, done.
Priya: Can I bulk-tag?
Ben: Not yet, it's on the roadmap for spring.
note: Internal training. All-negative chunk.

text:
Ruth: This is confidential: we're in early talks to acquire a small Berlin startup. Nothing is signed. Does anyone have concerns about integrating their stack?
Hana: Depends what they run. Do we know?
Ruth: Not yet, we'll get access to their repos after the LOI.
note: Confidential M&A.
